## Example: Marine sample data flow

Suppose the Family Process Matrix identifies passive acoustic recordings as the target family. A first observation might produce this flow:

```text
Receive recordings -> Validate files -> Run detector -> Review detections -> Publish results
```

Paste that line into the script box in the [interactive workspace](./current-primary.qmd), then choose **Create diagram from text**. The generated blocks provide a starting point in Draw.io; add queues, decisions, information flows, and rework that you observe.

## Add evidence to each block

Select or enter the matching process-block label in the metadata panel. For **Run detector**, the Software/Administrative VSM template might record:

| Field | Example observation |
|---|---|
| Funding | Annual project allocation |
| Code Errors | 3 failed jobs this month |
| Data Errors | 2 malformed recording headers |
| Security/Permissions | Controlled server access |
| Approvals | Science lead review |

Save a new metadata record whenever an observation changes. Records are appended with timestamps, so the exported CSV preserves the history rather than only the latest value.

## Export the result

Use **Export all diagram formats** to download the editable `.drawio` source, an editable `.drawio.svg`, and an editable `.png`. Export the metadata history separately, then save or move all four files into `output/`.
